stem.text: The diagram shows how nicotine is transported from the blood plasma into a cell using a type of cotransporter mechanism.

stem.alt: Diagram of a cotransporter protein spanning the cell surface membrane, with blood plasma above and cytoplasm below. Arrows show protons moving out of the cell and nicotine moving into the cell, with labels as printed.

stem.text: In the phloem tissue, there is a cotransporter mechanism that moves sucrose into the cytoplasm of a companion cell.
Which statement correctly describes a similarity between the cotransport of nicotine and the cotransport of sucrose?

A.text: The cotransporter proteins generate a proton gradient by moving protons out of the cell by active transport.

B.text: The protons are transported through the cotransporter proteins by facilitated diffusion.

C.text: The protons move through the cotransporter proteins in the opposite direction to the movement of nicotine and sucrose.

D.text: The cotransporter proteins use energy from ATP to transport protons with nicotine and sucrose.
